performance.title: OCR performance
performance.autoHint: In automatic mode, at least half of the cores are kept free (recommended: {{recommended}} of {{cpu}}).
performance.manualHint: In manual mode, you choose how many pages are processed at the same time.
performance.allCoresWarning: All cores will be used — the PC may become sluggish during OCR.
performance.coresBusy: About {{effective}} core(s) busy, ~{{free}} left free to use the PC.
performance.moreWorkers: More workers = faster, but more cores and VRAM used.
performance.threadsHint: Keep it at 1: too many threads × workers saturates the CPU and slows everything down.
performance.poolThresholdHint: Below this number of pages, OCR stays sequential (starting the pool isn't worth it).
